outcome: Control and optimization of hemodynamic and cardiac function
cohort: A 37-year-old pregnant woman diagnosed with peripartum cardiomyopathy who required an emergency cesarean section due to failed pharmacologic induction.
finding: Epidural anesthesia was successfully performed for an emergency cesarean section in a patient with peripartum cardiomyopathy.
mod_finding: The case demonstrates the successful anesthetic management of an emergency cesarean section in a high-risk patient with peripartum cardiomyopathy.
